name: MoonFixerUpper
author: MSML
description:
Fixes for bugs in the game itself. Each fix can be turned off in SETTINGS (here, or MOD SETTINGS in the pause menu).

Moon Sweepers 1.0.5 fixed "Could not pack a capsule" itself (the 10,000-capsule limit is gone), so this mod's fix for it was removed. More fixes are coming.
